faqs.question: What is the duration of BDes Interior Design course?
faqs.answer: BDes Interior Design is a four-year bachelor's degree. Two semesters are covered in each each. So, there are a total of 8 semesters in the course.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of pursuing B.Des in Interior Design?
faqs.answer: Students are encouraged to think creatively and develop original design solutions by B.Des in Interior Design. They also gain technical skills that are essential in the field of interior design, such as comprehending architectural drawings and mastering design software.

faqs.question: What is the best option for Interior Design, a BSc or a BDes?
faqs.answer: The major difference between BDes Interior Design and BSc Interior Design is that BSc is focused on the technical and scientific elements of Interior Design and usually works for its mathematical and engineering principles. Meanwhile, BDes focused on the specialisation's artistic and creative side . So, it depends on your interests and career choices, whether you want to go for BDes in Interior Design or BSc in Interior Design.

faqs.question: What is the difference between BA in interior designing and B.Des in interior designing?
faqs.answer:
Hi,

BA stands for Bachelor of arts in interior design, where it is also an academic degree related to theoretical skills, knowledge and study.

B.Design stands for Bachelor of design. It is a job oriented and a professional degree with practical trainings and skills, which makes a person ready for job.

BDes Interior Design Admission Process 2025
The admission process for the BDes in Interior Design program may vary depending on the college; however, here's a general overview of steps included in the procedure for candidates' reference:
Step I: Check the eligibility criteria
The candidates applying for Interior Design courses should ensure that they fulfil the eligibility criteria prescribed by Interior Design colleges and the entrance exam conducting body.
Step II: Fill the application

The students are suggested to carefully read the official notification of the entrance exam. Students would have to enter their details, upload necessary documents and make a fee payment to complete the online registration process.
Step III: Download the admit card
Students should download and take printout of the admit card.
Step IV: Appear for entrance exam
They should be present in their assigned exam centre at the said time as per the admit card. They should also carry other necessary documents, photographs, IDs etc.
Step V: Participate in the seat allotment process
Most Interior Design colleges conduct a document verification process followed by seat allotment.
Step VI: Pay the B Des Interior Design fees
The candidates should pay the admission fee to confirm admission to the Interior Design course. This is the last step in the Interior Design admission procedure.

faqs.answer:
BDes Interior Design is an undergraduate course which can be pursued by candidates who have completed Class 12. But, candidates can pursue various diploma or certificate courses after completing Class 10 such as:

• Diploma in Interior Design
• Certificate Course in Interior Design
• Diploma in Interior Design and Architecture

faqs.question: Is there any age criteria to pursue B.Des in Interior Design?
faqs.answer: Yes , there is an age limit for admission to a Bachelor of Design (BDes) in Interior Design programme at some colleges: General: Typically 20–24 years old on August 1 of the year of admission. SC, ST, and PwD: A 5-year relaxation in the age limit.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for a B Des in Interior Design from NIFT?
faqs.answer:
The eligibility criteria for a B Des in Interior Design from NIFT include:

• The age of the candidate should be less than 24 years as of August 1,  2025 .
• Relaxation in the upper age limit of 5 years is only applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, and PwD .
• The academic eligibility requires candidates to pass Class 12 from a recognised board with a minimum of 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: Are there any specific skills required to be eligible for BDes Interior Designing course?
faqs.answer: Hi, there are no mandatory skills you should learn to be eligible for a BDes Interior Designing course, however, some basic skills are essential to have while opting for a creative programme like Interior Design. For instance, a creative approach, good observational skills, artistic visualization, sketching ability, time management , etc., will help you learn better and grow in your field.

faqs.question: Is there any GD-PI round in the BDes in Interior Design admission process?
faqs.answer: No , Group Discussions or Personal Interview rounds are not mandatory in the BDes in Interior Design admission process. Fulfilling the eligibility criteria and obtaining a good rank in the entrance exam is the only step you need to clear to be eligible for the BDes in Interior Design admission.

faqs.question: What is the difference between NIFT and UCEED?
faqs.answer: The National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) entrance examination is an Institutional based examination that will only help you to get into the National Institute of Fashion Technology whereas the Undergraduate common entrance exam for design UCEED is a common Entrance Examination which is accepted by many design colleges and universities. The NIFT is an autonomous institute that offers courses in fashion, design, technology, and management. NIFT's head office is located in New Delhi, India. The UCEED is an entrance examination conducted by IIT, Bombay. It is a joint entrance examination for admission into B. Des programme at IIT Bombay, IIT Guwahati, and IITD Jabalpur. I hope this will help you.

faqs.question: What will be the pattern for NID DAT Prelims?
faqs.answer:
The NID DAT 2026 (Prelims) exam will be conducted on December 21, 2025.

As per the official pattern, the DAT Prelims exam wil be conducted offline and will be of 3 hours duration. The test will be conducted in English language and include a maximum of 26 questions. The question paper will include both subjective and objective-type questions. The paper will be for 100 marks. Candidate who qualify in DAT Prelims have to next appear in DAT Mains.

The candidate needs to consult the exam pattern along with the syllabus to prepare for the NID that exam. Note that the National Institute of Design also has the authority to make changes to the exam pattern.

faqs.question: What is the frequency of the Pearl Academy entrance exam?
faqs.answer:
Pearl Academy entrance exam is conducted in multiple cycles, in January, April and June. Candidate has the option to choose any of these cycles. Note that applications are received separately for each cycle.

Application form is open for UG and PG programmes.

faqs.question: Do we need to join coaching to prepare for NIFT entrance exam?
faqs.answer:
Joining a coaching for NIFT preparation is not really needed. Coaching is for those who want to learn how to draw things. But, if someone has this talent, which most students passionate about sketching and painting do possess, there is no need for coaching. One can prepare through self-study.
For your understanding, I would like to give an example.
In coaching, students are made to learn how to draw the 3D image by various techniques using measuring instruments but one who is natural at art can imagine what 3D image would look like if it has to be drawn on a paper and would draw the same.
In both cases, the outcome is the same.
Regarding theory, that is, GAT, if you are confident to solve Maths, History, Geography, General science up till class 10th level, then there is definitely no need for coaching. Though the level of English is a bit high you can improve it yourself.
